# dimdams_services (Data Source)

Services du compte (et ceux partagés avec lui).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dimdams_services" "vps" {
  type = "vps"
}

output "vps_names" {
  value = [for s in data.dimdams_services.vps.services : s.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `type` (String) Ne garder qu'un type (web, vps…).

### Read-Only

- `services` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--services))

<a id="nestedatt--services"></a>
### Nested Schema for `services`

Read-Only:

- `domain` (String) Adresse publique, s'il en a une.
- `id` (String) Identifiant du service.
- `name` (String) Nom.
- `status` (String) État (running, stopped…).
- `subtype` (String) Sous-type (nginx, nodejs, ubuntu…).
- `type` (String) Type (web, bot, vps, db, minecraft…).
